declare @s nvarchar(128), @l int, @size int, @i int select top 0 identity(int, 1, 1) as id, stt_rec, cast('' as varchar(max)) as stt_rec0, cast('' as char(6)) as p, nh_dk, line_nbr into #tagRow from r00$000000 a right join (select null as nul) b on 1 = 0 select @size = 0 select @i = 1, @l = datalength(text) from @k select @size = charindex(',', text, @size) from @k
while @size > 0 begin select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @size - @i), '''', '') from @k insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s)-1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s))) select @i = @size + 1 select @size = charindex(',', text, @size + 1) from @k end if @i < @l begin select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @l - @i), '''', '') from @k insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s)-1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s))) end update #tagRow set p = convert(char(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) from #tagRow a join &FlowMultiGeneralTable; b with(index(stt_rec)) on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
update #tagRow set nh_dk = left(stt_rec0, 3), line_nbr = substring(stt_rec0, 4, 33)
declare @p char(6), @r nvarchar(4000), @q nvarchar(4000)
select top 0 tr.id, a.ma_vv into #d from #tagRow tr cross join r00$000000 a
set @r = ' insert into #d select tr.id, a.ma_vv from (select id, stt_rec, nh_dk, line_nbr from #tagRow where p = ''%Partition'') tr join r00$%Partition a on tr.stt_rec = a.stt_rec and tr.nh_dk = a.nh_dk and tr.line_nbr = a.line_nbr '
select distinct p into #p from #tagRow select @p = min(p) from #p while @p is not null begin set @q = replace(@r, '%Partition', @p) exec sp_executesql @q select @p = min(p) from #p where p > @p end
select '' as array$, id, &OtherCopyField; from #d &FlowMultiOrderBy; return
